ios.desc:
Track your calories in under 3 seconds with AI. Simply snap a photo of your meal, and YouCal instantly calculates calories, protein, carbs, and fats. No tedious manual searching, no barcode hunting, and zero intrusive ads.

Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain, intermittent fasting, or maintaining a healthy lifestyle, YouCal is the modern, effortless nutrition tracker designed for your busy life.

KEY FEATURES:
• Instant AI Photo Food Logging: Point your camera at any meal. YouCal's smart computer vision detects ingredients, portion sizes, and complete nutritional values in seconds.
• Precision Macro & Calorie Tracking: Set personalized daily targets for calories, protein, carbs, and fats with visual progress rings.
• Integrated Intermittent Fasting: Built-in support for 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, and custom fast timers with metabolic stage indicators.
• Millions of Verified Foods & Barcode Scanner: Scan packaged food barcodes in milliseconds.
• Smart Calorie Deficit Guidance: Understand exactly how your intake aligns with your weight loss timeline.
• Seamless Apple Health Integration: Automatically syncs workouts, active burned calories, and steps.
• 100% Private & Ad-Free: Your health data stays yours. No third-party tracking, no ads.

Subscription Required - YouCal is available as a subscription with a 3-day free trial. All pricing is displayed in the app before purchase.
Medical Disclaimer: YouCal provides general health, fitness, and nutrition information for educational purposes only. It does not offer medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making decisions related to your health.
